verdict.rationale: JumpCloud is an identity, directory and device-management platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows no embedded agent that could plug in MCP servers. The mention of 'agent' identities refers to managing agent identities in the directory, not consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
